# Research pull request evidence

## Research contract

- Issue / experiment record:
- Decision this informs:
- Hypothesis and explicit non-goals:
- Risk level (L0–L3) and owner gate:
- Disposal or destination if successful:

## Evidence

- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Reproducible command, inputs, environment/provider settings, and result recorded
- [ ] Success and falsifying/negative path run
- [ ] Documentation links and experiment status updated

## Safety and integration

- [ ] No secrets, personal data, saves, proprietary game assets, raw model transcript, or generated build output
- [ ] No unapproved shared infrastructure, DSH internal dependency, or Player2 promotion
- [ ] Base refreshed; no force-push after review without an explicit reason
- [ ] Owner approval attached for L1 or above
